mechanism_narrative: A strong growth in GDP indicates a robust economy, which leads to increased consumer spending and higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, and ultimately negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong growth in payroll employment, indicates a tight labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates a decrease in supply, leading to higher prices and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong growth in housing starts indicates a robust housing market, leading to increased consumer spending and higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate, combined with a decline in the consumer price index, indicates a tightening monetary cycle with low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with low inflation
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of tightening monetary cycle with low inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate indicates a weak labor market, leading to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong growth in retail sales, combined with a decline in the federal funds rate, indicates a robust consumer spending environment, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales growth and low federal funds rate (t-test p > 0.05).
